_source: Verbatim Thai i18n PHRASE consumed by LandBank (pototype/land.jsx LandBank L137-220), kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so no Thai literal sits in land-bank.tsx — same pattern as customer-strings.json / boq-strings.json. CONSUME-ONLY, nothing minted here. Confirmed present in i18n-full.json phrases: ล้านบาท (L19914).
